reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown argue Jesus was not disclaiming his goodness but redirecting the rich young ruler to recognize the divine identity behind that title.

sides.snippet: Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God.
sides.verseText: He said to him, \"Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.\"
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
